h1: Custom Shot Glasses in Bulk with Your Logo
lead: Customize plastic and silicone shot glasses for tastings, bar service, brand promotions and events. Compare our listed 1.5 oz, 2 oz and LED styles, then send your logo or idea. We provide free design proposals and product mockups showing the artwork on the chosen cup.
html:
Questions Before You Order

Is a shot glass always 1.5 oz or 2 oz?

A shot glass is not one universal size. Our listed shot-cup range includes 1.5 oz and 2 oz options. Choose the required serving capacity, then check the selected model’s capacity and dimensions before ordering.

Can I order custom plastic shot glasses with my logo?

Yes. We print logos and patterns on plastic shot cups and provide free design proposals and product mockups. Choose a listed plastic or acrylic LED model and send your artwork or idea.

Do you offer silicone shot glasses as well as plastic styles?

Yes. Our range includes silicone shot cups and acrylic LED styles. Silicone cups use UV printing or color-changing ink; plastic shot cups use screen printing. The mockup shows the artwork on the model you select.

What is the minimum quantity for a custom shot-glass bulk order?

One-color logo printing starts at 250 pieces, two colors at 1,000 and three colors at 2,000. The product model also has its own minimum order quantity; both requirements apply.

Can I see my logo on a shot cup before production?

Yes. Send your logo, pattern, sketch or idea. We provide a free design proposal and digital product mockup. A physical sample is a separate step in the project quotation.

Can you develop a new plastic shot-cup shape?

Yes. Send your concept, target capacity and quantity for our OEM/ODM workflow. We develop the shape and structure, then proceed through tooling, sample approval and production.

What should I send for a bulk shot-glass quotation?

Email niles@boomdrinkware.com with the cup model or shape idea, quantity, logo colors, packaging, destination and required arrival date. We use those details to prepare the design proposal and project quotation.

Email Your Shot-Cup Brief for Free Design and a Bulk Quote

Email: niles@boomdrinkware.com
